props.title: Every site you own. ==One calm dashboard==.
props.subtitle: Lightweight monitoring for a whole fleet of small websites.

slides.notes: Open quietly: this is a small tool for a real, everyday pain — running a dozen small sites and wondering which one is broken right now.

props.title: Somebody has to ==tell you== it's down.

left.label: Today
left.title: You find out by accident
points: A visitor emails: is the site broken?
A client notices before you do
Or nobody tells you — at all
A dozen sites, a dozen hosts, no single view

right.label: The usual fix
right.title: Enterprise monitoring
points: Overkill for a handful of small sites
More setup than the sites themselves

slides.notes: The gap: between 'no monitoring' and 'enterprise suite' there is almost nothing. That gap is where Site Monitor lives.

tiles.title: Up
tiles.body: Sites responding as expected, checked on a schedule.

tiles.title: Down
tiles.body: A failed check is flagged the moment it happens — not when a client calls.

tiles.title: Changed
tiles.body: Content or status drift gets surfaced, so silent breakage can't hide.

slides.notes: Three questions, one screen: what's up, what's down, what changed. That's the whole product promise.

props.caption: background daemons, heavyweight stacks, or server gymnastics — pragmatic checks that fit the platform
props.foot: Designed to run inside SpaceFast's simple static / PHP hosting

slides.notes: Site Monitor is shaped by where it runs: SpaceFast's simple static/PHP hosting. Nothing to install, nothing always-on — just checks that fit the platform.

items.title: Add your sites
items.body: Point the monitor at each URL in your fleet.

items.title: It checks on a schedule
items.body: Each site gets pinged and verified — not just reached, actually checked.

items.title: Results roll up
items.body: Every check lands in one status view for the whole fleet.

slides.notes: Walk the loop: add sites, scheduled pings with real verification, one roll-up view. Emphasize 'verified' — a ping alone can lie.

items.title: Scheduled checks
items.body: Pings plus content verification on a cadence you choose.

items.title: Fleet-wide status
items.body: Every site, one glance — up, down, or changed.

items.title: Change detection
items.body: Silent drift gets surfaced instead of hiding for weeks.

items.title: Zero extra infra
items.body: No daemons, no stack to babysit — it lives where your sites live.

slides.notes: Four features, all in service of the same calm. Don't read the tiles — pick the one that matters to this audience and expand.
